label: orama.hybrid_search
reason: Search limit increased (1000→1030), which can increase the amount of work performed by Orama's hybrid search (vector+term scoring), raising latency and CPU; this is typically the dominant cost in the request path.

label: search.postprocess.levenshtein_rerank
reason: With a higher search limit, `vectorResult.hits` grows, increasing the cost of per-hit candidate mapping, Levenshtein-based reranking, and Map construction/lookup; these steps scale with hit count and can become significant at ~1k+ hits.
return_value_change: May return a slightly larger ordered result set (due to upstream limit bump), which can increase work for callers iterating over results.

label: rateLimiterMiddleware.consume.success_latency
reason: Mongo-backed rate limiter consume() is likely the dominant cost in this middleware (DB/network I/O + possible contention). Measuring end-to-end latency from middleware entry until the success continuation (next()) helps quantify per-request overhead and tail latency impact.

label: rateLimiterMiddleware.consume.error_handling
reason: New console.debug logging was added in the error path; while this path may be less frequent, when rate limiting triggers it can become hot and logging/serialization of the error object can add noticeable overhead and noise under load. Measuring catch-path handling isolates the incremental impact of the new log.
